newsitem.title: USA: Florida gives $32 million for community develpment.
newsitem.headline: Florida gives $32 million for community develpment.

text.p: Florida has awarded a total of $32 million to rebuild and revitalize 45 counties and cities, Department of Community Affairs Secretary Jim Murley said Tuesday.

The funding will allow them to rehabilitate hundreds of low to moderate income houses, help residents find new jobs, allow communities to construct water and sewage lines, and to build neighbourhood centers, parks and playgrounds.
It will help cities with a population of less than 50,000 and counties with less than 200,000 low to moderate income residents.
The state granted 40 per cent of the funds for neighbourhood revitalization, 40 per cent for housing, 10 per cent for economic revitalization and 10 per cent for commercial revitalization.
